# 1InTheOffice Graph Ruled Spiral Notebook, Quad Ruled Notebook Spiral, 100 Sheets, 8" H x 10 1/2" W 2 Pack
Brand: 1InTheOffice
Category: Paper > Graph Paper

## Features
Spiral-bound Graph notebook for easy page turning; Each pad measures 8"H x 10 1/2"w; Micro perforated sheets tear off cleanly and easily; 4 squares per inch (4x4) graph paper; 100 sheets per pad assorted colors randomly assigned to each order

## Specifications
Color: Assorted; Paper Size: 4x6 inches; Special Features: Soft Cover; Unit Count: 2 Count; Best Sellers Rank: #184,897 in Office Products (See Top 100 in Office Products)#132 in Graph Paper

## Pricing & Reviews
Price: 8.99 USD.
Rated 4.5 from 178 reviews.

## Description
Make precise drawings and graph out math problems with this graphing grid notebook from us. The color of the protective cover on this handy notebook is randomly assigned. Graphing Squares With four graphing squares per inch, the notebook lets you easily draw things to scale. If you need loose sheets instead of a notebook, try 1InTheOffice graphing pads instead. Spiral Bound The spiral binding makes it easy to turn pages and flip to exactly the drawing or graph you need. The durable binding also securely holds your pages in place so that important drawings don't get lost. Perforated Sheets Each sheet is perforated at the edge, so you can pull a single sheet out to share at any time. The microperforations make the pages come out easier, so you won't have to worry about accidental tearing while you remove one.

Top review: I normally shop for school supplies at the local Walmart. This year they were compeltely out of graph notebooks the week before start of school. I live in a rural area where Walmart is basically the one place to shop for school supplies, unless you want to jump in the car and drive for a couple of hours. I decided to check on Amazon. I am a prime member and have fast free shipping (highly recommend the membership). Found this notbook and ordered what I needed. It got there in time for my sons first math class. It is of good quality. Perhaps next year I will do all my school supplies on Amazon? Sure beats fighting the crowd when the entire town is out looking for supplies and the lines are loooooooooooooong. Recommend this graph paper. Will definitely buy again.
